notes:
- STYLE no longer traps you: the ‹ and › arrows now step back and forward, New look… is its own stop (click it to open), and the list wraps back to Noir Ink.
- Run as administrator by mistake? Inkreel now restarts itself normally, so its window no longer comes up black.

- The four classic looks are redrawn the way a comic is inked: real ink outlines, faces and people kept clear, calmer backgrounds, solid blacks in Noir, clean screentones in Manga, and the film's own colours as flat inks in Pop and Clean Line. Comics made with them are inked again the next time you make them.

- Inkreel installs itself: the first time you run the download, it copies itself to your user folder and adds Inkreel to the desktop and Start menu. After that you can delete the download, and updates go to the installed copy.
- It picks up where you left off: the last movie opens again with its comic ready to read, and an unfinished comic comes back paused, ready to resume.
- My comics: every comic you've made, with its cover. Click one to open it in the Book.
- CBZ: save for comic-reader apps (manga marked right to left).

- Print: choose a paper in Save: US comic, Euro album, Manga (B6), Digest, US Letter, A4, A5, Tabloid, A3, A4 landscape, or a custom size. Pages are laid out again for its shape: small paper gets fewer panels a page, so words never go under 7 pt. A fixed length like 64 pages stays 64 pages.
- Saved PDFs carry the words as real text, so they're sharp at any size.
- Bleed and crop marks for a print shop, or a booklet to print double-sided at home, fold and staple (A5 pages on A4 sheets, Digest on Letter).

- New style: Film's own. Inkreel measures the film's colours from its frames and prints the comic in them, as a flat screen-print palette. Drawn and animated films keep their own colours with firmer outlines, and Inkreel suggests this look when a film looks drawn.
- New look from pictures: go past the last STYLE to open it, then add 3 to 20 posters, stills or comic pages. Inkreel reads their colours, outlines, shading and paper grain, shows two frames of your movie in the look, and saves it to your Comics folder's Looks folder so it appears in STYLE.
- Changing a look never watches the film again.

- Sound effects: WHAM!, BLAM!, CRASH! and BOOM! lettered on the film's loudest moments, and from sound tags in subtitles like [GUNSHOT]. Drag, retype or delete them in the Book like balloons. Turn them off in Settings > Words.
- Manga Tone reads right to left: pages, balloons and the Book's spreads run from the right, and the PDF opens that way in viewers. Settings > Comics switches it back.
- Settings has the two new switches. Changing one re-letters the comic without watching the film again.

- The Book: click any page to fix it. Move, retype or delete balloons, aim their tails, reframe a panel, swap in another moment of the shot, or take a panel out. Undo works page by page.
- Better balloons: Inkreel now finds people and things in each shot, not just faces, keeps the words off them, and crops each panel to leave room for its words.
- Fast PDFs: the PDF is written in seconds, so saving a fixed page is quick.
- Updates: Inkreel checks for new versions and installs one when you choose it. Every update is signed with Inkreel's release key.
